policy: No model enters numeric ranking until a locked local checkpoint, dataset and runner have produced a complete like-for-like result. Missing or corrupt assets fail closed; LJ and cached outputs are forbidden fallbacks.

models.intendedUse: Research and experimental atomistic energy, force, stress and molecular-dynamics evaluation; real-world materials use requires additional validation.
outOfScope: unvalidated polymers, surfaces, interfaces and long-range interactions
quantitative use outside the documented chemical and thermodynamic envelope
models.levelOfTheory: Materials-Project-like PBE/PBE+U training convention documented by MatterSim; not experimental ground truth.
models.energyConvention: Use raw model outputs with one frozen ASE stress/sign/unit conversion; do not mix with corrected formation energies without an explicit transform.

models.intendedUse: Research comparison and atomistic simulation with explicit checkpoint paths and documented MPA-0 domain checks.
outOfScope: direct comparison of raw PBE+U energies with MP2020-corrected energies
models.levelOfTheory: Raw PBE+U MPA-0 convention trained on MPTrj plus sAlex structures.
models.energyConvention: Raw PBE+U energies; never compare directly to MP2020-corrected energies without a frozen correction protocol.

benchmarks.license: MIT repository license; redistribution remains disabled pending dataset-specific confirmation
limitations: The MatterSim training corpus is closed, so Random-TP is not certified leakage-free by hash.
The file lacks per-frame temperature and pressure metadata; stress and volume are only OOD proxies.
The benchmark was produced by the MatterSim authors and may contain vendor-selection bias.
The upstream record does not expose a clear redistribution license or locked artifact digest; the null digest explicitly blocks local reproduction.
Published MatterSim and MACE metrics remain external auditable records until checkpoint inference is rerun.

runner.isolation: network-disabled, unprivileged container after verified download

integrity: Verify source revision, byte length and SHA-256 before checkpoint deserialization.
Require 693 frames, 11088 atoms, 89 elements, unique IDs and complete finite E/F/stress arrays.
Corrupt or missing checkpoints, records or output rows fail; fallback models and cached constants are forbidden.
Canonical per-record float64 outputs are Merkle-rooted by sorted structure ID.
metrics: energy MAE in eV/atom with p50/p90/p95/p99/max and worst IDs
mean per-atom force-vector error in eV/angstrom plus component MAE/RMSE
stress Frobenius error in GPa plus six-component MAE and fixed ASE sign convention
failure rate, missing IDs, batch-1 p50/p95 latency, atoms/s and peak GPU memory

randomTpAcceptance.maceFirstRunPolicy: Blind engineering-completeness baseline only; it cannot support a superiority claim.

mdSmoke.firstRunPolicy: Publish drift, minimum distance and maximum force before freezing a non-regression threshold.

abstention: strain, temperature or system size outside the frozen envelope
checkpoint, dataset, runner or unit provenance mismatch
process optimization request before reactor and flowsheet layers are validated

excludedDefaults.reason: The weights require identity-gated acceptance of FAIR Chemistry terms whose AUP restricts critical infrastructure, transportation, heavy machinery and nuclear uses; it is SOTA context only, not an industrial default.
excludedDefaults.license: FAIR Chemistry License with separate Acceptable Use Policy
obligations: acceptable-use review before every intended deployment

legalEvidence.accessStatus: identity-gated; anonymous fixed-revision GET returns HTTP 401
